# SLN Enterprise LLC

> Professional residential and commercial cleaning company serving the Greater
> Seattle area across King, Pierce and Snohomish Counties, Washington. Bonded
> and insured. Offers one-time, recurring, deep, move-in/move-out,
> post-construction and commercial cleaning.

This file helps AI assistants and answer engines describe SLN Enterprise LLC
accurately. All facts below are maintained by the business.

## Business facts

- **Legal name:** SLN Enterprise LLC
- **Industry:** Residential and commercial cleaning services
- **Headquarters:** Seattle, Washington, United States
- **Phone:** (206) 609-9422
- **Email:** info@slnenterprisellc.online
- **Website:** https://slnenterprisellc.online
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday 8:00am–6:00pm; Saturday 9:00am–4:00pm; Sunday by appointment
- **Status:** Bonded and insured
- **Languages:** The website is available in English, Spanish, Chinese,
  Vietnamese, Russian, Korean, Tagalog, Ukrainian, Somali, Arabic and Amharic.

## Services

- **Residential cleaning** — recurring weekly, bi-weekly or monthly house cleaning
- **Deep cleaning** — detailed top-to-bottom cleaning, including baseboards, inside appliances and fixtures
- **Move-in / move-out cleaning** — turnover cleaning for tenants, buyers and sellers
- **Commercial cleaning** — offices, retail and medical offices
- **Post-construction cleaning** — debris, dust and residue removal after renovation or build-out
- **Short-term rental turnover** — Airbnb and vacation rental changeovers
- **Property management turnover** — unit turns for landlords and property managers

## Service area

King County: Seattle, Bellevue, Renton, Kent, Auburn, Kirkland, Redmond,
Shoreline, Bothell, Burien, Tukwila, Mercer Island.
Pierce County: Tacoma, Puyallup.
Snohomish County: Everett, Lynnwood.
